description:
`Punctured<C>` implements no `ParityCheckMatrixAccess`, while `Shortened<C>` and `Extended<C>` do, so a punctured code cannot participate in the parity-check half of the shared matrix conformance cases.

## Background

Surfaced by the shortening fast path (`@/issue/203ee826`), which gave `Shortened<C>` parity-check access on both derivation paths. The rank machinery the transformations share already yields the dual basis a punctured code needs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Punctured<C>` implements `ParityCheckMatrixAccess` with a full-row-rank check matrix satisfying `G Hᵀ = 0`, and the shared conformance cases run it.
title: Punctured<C> lacks ParityCheckMatrixAccess
